# Cursor follow-up — PR #6795 custody binding blocker

You are fixing the existing branch/worktree for draft PR #6795. You are not alone in the repository; preserve all unrelated work and do not alter any path outside the original four-file scope.

Current reviewed head: `4ce2bf3296d4fda39ad324e85fdeae87bac64d07`.

Root reproduced a fail-closed provenance defect:

```text
private_jsonl_sha256 ACCEPTED
exactness_audit_sha256 ACCEPTED
content_fit_audit_sha256 REJECTED
```

The probe deep-copied the committed receipt, replaced each named binding with 64 zeroes, recomputed `receipt_sha256`, and called `validate_receipt()`. A resealed receipt can therefore forge two exact private-custody artifact identities and still pass `--check`.

Fix this root cause on the same PR:

1. Schema-const and runtime-bind `bindings.private_jsonl_sha256` to `PRIVATE_JSONL_SHA256`.
2. Schema-const and runtime-bind `bindings.private_jsonl_bytes` to `PRIVATE_JSONL_BYTES`.
3. Schema-const and runtime-bind `bindings.exactness_audit_sha256` to `EXACTNESS_AUDIT_SHA256`.
4. Audit the same receipt binding block for any sibling exact private-custody identity that is merely pattern-validated; bind it if it has an authoritative module constant. Do not invent new facts.
5. Add focused reseal-mutation tests proving every corrected field is rejected independently.
6. Regenerate the public receipt after final formatting so implementation/schema/self hashes agree.
7. Run the 56-test relevant suite (or its current exact successor), Ruff, source-blind `--check`, and the root mutation probe.
8. Commit with `X-Agent: cursor/phase3-6375-pr6795-custody-binding-fix-r1` and push to the existing PR branch. Keep the PR draft; do not merge or arm auto-merge.

Preserve all existing no-overclaim gates, exact source facts, privacy/permission invariants, and four-path scope. Report the new exact head, fields bound, test counts, receipt body hash, and mutation-probe result.
